"''We'll have to destroy them ship to ship. Get the crews to their fighters.|Lieutenant Tanbris and Darth Vader|audio=Tanbris-Vader-ANH.flac|}} [[Lieutenant]] '''Tanbris''' was a [[human]] [[Imperial officer|officer]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. During the [[Battle of Yavin]], the lieutenant was an [[aide]] on board the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[battle station]] and provided a report on enemy numbers to the [[Dark Lord of the Sith|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] when the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] attacked the [[Space station|station]]. Although Vader ordered Tanbris to have the station's [[Starfighter|fighter]] [[Imperial Starfighter Corps|crews]] prepare to launch, the [[Death Star]] was destroyed soon after. ==Biography== [[File:VaderTanbris-ANH.png|thumb|left|300px|Tanbris reported to Darth Vader on the Death Star.]] Tanbris''[[Star Wars Origami: 11 Amazing Paper Folding Projects from a Galaxy Far, Far Away.... Spacecraft]]'' was a [[human]] [[Imperial officer|officer]] of the [[Galactic Empire]] that held the rank of [[lieutenant]] and served as an [[aide]]{{Film|IV}} {{AD|Disney+}} on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[battle station]]. After [[Destruction of Alderaan|destroying]] the [[planet]] [[Alderaan]] in [[1 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition]]'' the [[Death Star]] traveled to the [[Yavin system]] in order to destroy the [[Great Temple|headquarters]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] located on the [[moon]] [[Yavin 4]].''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]'' The rebels launched thirty [[starfighter]]s to [[Battle of Yavin|combat]] the [[Imperial Military|Imperial forces]]. Due to the small size of the [[Starship|vessels]], the fighters were able to evade the Empire's [[turbolaser]]s and make it to the surface of the [[Space station|station]]. On board the Death Star, Tanbris hurriedly approached the [[Dark Lord of the Sith|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] in one of the corridors and informed him of the rebels' numbers and evasiveness. Vader ordered the lieutenant to have the station's [[Imperial Starfighter Corps|fighter crews]] get to their vehicles so that they could destroy the rebels in [[Starfighter combat|fighter-to-fighter combat]]. Although [[Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin]], [[commander]] of the Death Star, refused to issue a launch order, Vader scrambled a single [[squadron]] of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter|TIE fighters]]—[[Black Squadron (Galactic Empire)|Black Squadron]]—on his own authority.''[[Star Wars: On the Front Lines]]'' The [[TIE series|TIEs]] soon launched from the station and engaged the rebel fighters, but they were unable to prevent them from destroying the Death Star. ==Personality and traits== Tanbris had [[Color|brown]] [[hair]], light skin, and blue [[eye]]s. ==Equipment== Tanbris wore a black [[Imperial officer's uniform|uniform]] of the [[Imperial Officer Corps]] with a matching [[Imperial kepi|cap]] that included a [[officer's disk]]. The lieutenant also wore a black and silver [[utility belt]], black [[boot]]s, two [[Imperial code cylinder]]s, and a [[rank insignia plaque]] with four blue squares. ==Behind the scenes== In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], Tanbris first appeared in the [[1977]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']]. [[Andy Bradford]], who did stunt work on the film,{{ThisWeek|4_3IbhbVMsY|Build the LEGO Mos Eisley Cantina, Look Inside Marvel's Star Wars: The High Republic Comic, and More!|sw_url=video/build-the-lego-mos-eisley-cantina-look-inside-marvel-s-star-wars-the-high-republic-comic-and-more}} portrayed Tanbris.{{Facebook|username=LondonFilmandComicCon/|url=LondonFilmandComicCon/posts/andy-bradford-is-coming-to-london-film-comic-con-andy-is-an-extremely-busy-stunt/1102970566554153|date=2019-06-28|quote=ANDY BRADFORD is coming to London Film & Comic Con. Andy is an extremely busy stunt performer and coordinator who has accumulated over 250 credits so far! Andy played Lt. Tanbris in Star Wars: Episode IV - A New Hope.|archivefile=File:ComicCon-AndyBradford.png}} Bradford's scene was filmed on Stage 2 at [[Elstree Studios]] between [[June 17]] and [[June 28]], [[1976]].''[[The Making of Star Wars]]'' The character's name was then first used in canon in the [[2016]] activity book ''[[Star Wars Origami: 11 Amazing Paper Folding Projects from a Galaxy Far, Far Away.... Spacecraft]]'', which was written by [[Chris Alexander]]. In the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, the character appeared prior to the release of the film in its 1976 [[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|novelization]] by [[Alan Dean Foster]].[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'' novelization]] The character's name originated in Legends on a card in the [[1995]] ''[[Premiere Limited]]'' set for the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]] produced by [[Decipher]]{{CCG|set=Premiere Limited|cardname=Lieutenant Tanbris}} ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Tanbris|soundcat=Audio files of Tanbris}} *{{Film|IV}} {{1st}} *[[Star Wars: A New Hope (paperback novel)|''Star Wars: A New Hope'' junior novelization]] *''[[Star Wars: A New Hope Cinestory Comic]]'' ==Sources== *''[[Star Wars Origami: 11 Amazing Paper Folding Projects from a Galaxy Far, Far Away....
